book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso nyaŋɛ bamii banchvuge banɛh
Gɛh aju ayu le, kinchvu ki bamii ka ki to ki taashɛ nɛ gɛmm. Bo gɛ̀ kɛme gɛ mwɛɛ munjile gɛ, Jiso tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋkɛme yii fɛ kinchvu kinɛ le, nje bo le wa besa bo aju atade, fiɛɛ fì bo ji nyume gɛ yu gɛ.
Nɛ nchinɛ lo bo tuu ala aboo le, bo gɛɛŋ bo gwe jɛŋ a je, no bamu ja jé yì ndefe le.”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo chvuu lɛ, “Taŋlo muh jo faaŋ mwɛɛ munjile nchvuuŋ yanɛ ki wu nyâŋɛ kfuu chi banɛ bamii yu?”
Wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme chefe yi blɛd yimiɛɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Le bvusooshwi.”
Jiso mo wu du lɛ kinchvu ki bamii kiyu shii fɛkuu. Bo shiiyɛ, wu jo chefe yi blɛd yì bvusooshwi chiɛɛ, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu bweeyɛ, wu nya booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, bo gajɛ kinchvu kiyu le.
Bo gɛ̀ kɛme tɛ bíɛŋ yì shige shige nɛ shige. Wu ka wu jo, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu jɛmɛ bo gajɛ bamii bayu le.
Muh wuchii ji wu fuu. Bo baanyɛ bimbɛge bì gɛ̀ shɛshɛ, bi yisɛ ŋkáa bvusooshwi.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ ji gɛ̀ bee njɛ banchvuge banɛh.
Wu mo wu chinɛ bo le bo kwɛɛde. Wu lee lo a ŋguh le kimimia bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ kimbe kì Damanuta le.
Bafalashii tu bo goone lɛ Jiso dunyɛ kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ
Bafalashii gɛ̀ ja bo to fɛ Jiso le, bo kɛ kintɛɛnyɛ bɛ wu, bo jɛme lɛ wu ge fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvu ja fɛwe. Bo gɛ̀ duu noo bo mone lo wu.
Jiso shooŋ baaŋ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Kiŋgogɛ kinɛ goone fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvu ja fɛwe ki ge la yu? Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ kiŋgogɛ kinɛ nyu ki yɛŋ fiɛɛ le gɛ.”

content: Wu mo wu chinɛ bo le, wu kaasɛ wu lee a ŋguh le, wu tu wu gɛɛne wuŋ kwɛge.
Jiso tefɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛ bo yɛ̂de kune gee chi Bafalashii bɛ chi Hɛlod lɛ
Jiso gɛ̀ gɛɛne booŋ be ba ŋgoo daayɛ ki bo jo blɛd, bo gɛ̀ kɛme gɛh nyu chefe yimimia a ŋguh le.
Wu tu wu teefe bo wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne, bɛŋ ka bɛŋ jôde kife yi kinshilɛ ki Bafalashii le mo ki Hɛlod.”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo kɛ bo jɛme lɛbolɛbo kune fiɛɛ fiyu, bo duu lɛ, “Wu jɛme kinshilɛ kinɛ nɛ nje besabɛŋ baaŋ kɛmɛ gɛ blɛd gɛ.”
Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo jɛme kune fi, wu mo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jɛme nyu kune blɛd wù bɛŋ baaŋ kɛme gɛ nje la? Gɛ bɛŋ yɛde mwɛɛ le kɛnɛ bɛŋ kee mwɛɛ gɛ? Le lɛ bvufee bwena baaŋ a gwenyɛ gɛ?
Bɛŋ kɛme ajii bɛŋ yɛde gɛ mwɛɛ le gɛ? Bɛŋ kɛme bintuŋ bɛŋ yuge gɛ mwɛɛ gɛ? Gɛ bɛŋ kwaji mwɛɛ gɛ?
Sege ŋgɛ̀ ŋgweeshɛ chefe yi blɛd yishɛŋ yì bamii chi ji banchvuge batɛŋ, bimbɛge bì bɛŋ chi banyɛ chi bee ŋkáa yimiɛɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Yuufe ncho yifiɛɛ.”
Wu ka wu biih,

content.text: “Kune chefe yì bvusooshwi yì bamii be ji banchvuge banɛh, bimbɛge bì bɛŋ be banyɛ be bee ŋkáa yimiɛɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “bvusooshwi.”
Wu mo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ kɛɛ wa mwɛɛ gɛ?”

content: Jiso gwenyɛ ajii a kinfeeŋ ntɛ wù Bɛsada le
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ daŋ bo bu Bɛsada, bamii bamu to bɛ kinfeeŋ kimi fɛ wu le bo lɛgɛ lɛ wu kuŋ wu le, wu fɛ wu.
Jiso jijɛ wu yi kibo le, bɛ wu bu ntɛ wuyu le. Wu chuuyɛ nchwene yi ajii a we le, wu gɛɛ chiaaŋ yi ye ye le wu mo wu biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo yɛde fiɛɛ le?”

content: Kinfeeŋ kiyu chiaasɛ ajii we, ki bijɛ ki jɛmɛ lɛ, “N'yɛde bamii le jibejibe bo jiɛnyi nyu njɛ bite.”
Jiso ka wu gɛɛ chiaaŋ yi ajii a muh wuyu le, wu bijɛ nɛ tuŋŋ, ajii a we mo wo yuu, wu tu wu yɛde mwɛɛ le munchii chuule.
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo gɛ̂ɛne fɛ wo kfuuŋ, wo doo wo gɛɛne keefɛ wo ka wo lêe ntɛ le gɛ.”

content: Bita chiɛɛyɛ lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ja fo bo tu bo gɛɛne bantɛ ba kimbe kì Kasalia wu Filibi le. Bo doo bo gɛɛne, wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii duu lɛ nle yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Bamii bamu duu lɛ wo le Joŋ Nlesɛajoo, bamu lɛ Alaja, bamu duu lɛ wo le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wumu.”
Wu mo wu kaasɛ wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ duu fiena lɛ nle yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bita chvuu lɛ, “Wo le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka.”
Jiso mo wu chiisɛ lo bo le lɛ keefɛ bo môŋ bo sɛ̂ɛŋ finɛ fiɛɛ muh le kune wu gɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ kune kfuu chi kwe yì wu lé wu gê wu kwe
Wu mo wu kɛ wu yɛyi booŋ be ba ŋgoo wu jɛme kune kikwɛɛ ke lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme ki wu yɛ̂ŋ baŋgɛ ba duude, bamii ba sage woŋ bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo faŋ wu. Bo mo bo yuuyɛ wu, aju fe atade wu kaasɛ wu bu yi kwe le.”

content: Wu jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ bo le nɛ waaŋ. Bita mo wu jo wu bɛ wu kɛŋsɛ yo, wu mo wu kɛ wu wame wu yi fiɛɛ fiyu le.
Jiso kaasɛ ye, wu bijɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo, wu waŋ Bita wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Jâ a mɛ jiŋ Sataŋ! Gɛ wo lɛme yi kimbe ki Nyo le gɛ. Wo lɛme nyu yi ki muh wu wuŋ le.”

content: Wu mo wu tɛɛŋ kinchvu ki bamii bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh nɛ goone ki wu bîi mɛne, tu wù kɛme ki wu fâŋ kikwɛɛ ke, wu tuu kintaaŋ ke wu bii mɛne.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wu baji kinche ke lɛ keefɛ wu lɛsɛ ki gɛ, lé wu gê wu lɛsɛ lo ki. Geenɛ, Muh wu lɛsɛ kinche ke nje mɛ mo nje saaka wù joŋe le, tu wu baji lo kinche kiyu.
Ba banyi woŋ kfunɛ wuchii ba nya muh ji, wu lɛsɛ kinche ke, maajɛ wuyu nyu la?
Fiɛɛ fì taŋlo muh suuŋ kiyo ke yu le la?

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ muh kɛme bvuya ki wu bîi mɛne mo jɛ yaŋ le, antɛnɛɛ a kiŋgogɛ ki ghɛge mwɛɛ kinɛ ki le njɛ muh wu chinɛ jwɛɛŋ le kɛnɛ kwɛɛ le wu tu wu jaŋe kinjaŋ, wu kêe lɛ muh wu jee che le Mwamuh, bvuya le bvu koo tɛ wu bɛ mwɛdɛ sege wu kaasɛ wu to antɛnɛɛ a bvukugɛ bvu Chiji bɛ banchɛndaa ba Nyo ba yuude.”
